excerpt_i18n.en: On November 5, the new version of QQ Browser for desktop was launched, officially introducing the "AI+" mini-window. For instance, when a video page is opened, it automatically suggests the "video summary" feature, and for long articles, it prioritizes the "webpage summary" function. 01 Conference Background
As oncology and cerebrovascular disease research enter an era of deep integration characterized by precision, multi-omics, and interdisciplinary approaches, a premier academic gathering of global expertise is set to take place in Shenzhen! From December 2–7, 2025, the Fourteenth International Workshop on Cancer Systems Biology (ICSB 2025) and the Longxing Program series will be held in Shenzhen. This conference marks the first expansion into the interdisciplinary field of cerebrovascular systems biology, inviting scholars worldwide to discuss breakthroughs in mechanisms, technological innovations, and clinical translation, establishing a high-level international platform for advancing precision medicine.

14 Years of Brand Legacy, Setting an Interdisciplinary Academic Benchmark
The International Workshop on Cancer Systems Biology (ICSB) and the Longxing Program, jointly initiated in 2011 by Professor Xu Ying of Southern University of Science and Technology and Professor Liang Yanchun of Jilin University, have consistently focused on breaking down disciplinary barriers, bridging basic and clinical research, and empowering young scholars. As a highly influential academic brand in the field, ICSB has successfully hosted 13 editions, attracting over 2,000 global participants, facilitating more than 50 international research collaborations, and driving breakthroughs in cutting-edge areas such as AI + cancer omics and metabolic regulation in cerebrovascular diseases.

Compared to other conferences in the field, ICSB offers three unique values:
Deep Interdisciplinary Integration: Focusing on the dual domains of oncology and cerebrovascular systems.
excerpt_i18n.es: Antecedentes de la reunión: Con la investigación oncológica y de enfermedades cerebrovasculares adentrándose en una era de integración profunda caracterizada por la precisión, la multiómica y la interdisciplinariedad, un evento académico que reúne a las mentes más destacadas del mundo está a punto de llegar a Shenzhen. Del 2 al 7 de diciembre de 2025, se celebrará con gran relevancia en Shenzhen el XIV Taller Internacional de Biología de Sistemas del Cáncer (ICBS 2025), junto con las actividades del Programa Estrella del Dragón. Por primera vez, esta edición amplía su enfoque hacia la biología de sistemas cerebrovasculares, invitando a académicos globales a debatir sobre los mecanismos.
